tool_args.rationale: The branch probe establishes that the sink gradient matters, but its two off-baseline observations each use a different drive. A gradient multiplier and a gradient-dependent resistance can both explain those points yet disagree at unmeasured drive–gradient combinations by more than the 0.045 tolerance. The trajectory batch is the remaining relevant probe for resolving that ambiguity before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It can match both branch observations, but neither gradient away from baseline was measured at a second drive level to test whether attenuation is independent of drive.

considered_alternatives.option: Gradient-dependent resistance in the two-layer bridge
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It can also match both branch observations while predicting a substantially different response at low drive. The current rows do not identify which transfer law to submit.
The auxiliary reading would not distinguish how drive and sink gradient jointly determine the response.
